takeaways.nhl:8484471: Emmitt Finnie draws cancer ribbon on stick knob to honor his mother Shannon, who overcame breast cancer and battles liver cancer.

stories.headline: Boldy scores hat trick, Wild hold off late Blues rally
stories.nhlSummary: ST. PAUL, Minn. -- Matt Boldy had a hat trick and an assist for the Minnesota Wild, who held off the St. Louis Blues for a 5-4 win at Grand Casino Arena on Thursday.

takeaways.nhl:8481557: Matt Boldy scored four points including a hat trick, demonstrating strong offensive production as part of Minnesota's top line.

stories.headline: Game Recap: Wild 5, Blues 4
stories.nhlSummary: ST. PAUL, Minn. -- Matt Boldy had a hat trick and an assist for the Minnesota Wild, who held off the St. Louis Blues for a 5-4 win at Grand Casino Arena on Thursday.

takeaways.nhl:8481557: Matt Boldy recorded a hat trick and assist in Wild's 5-4 win, scoring five goals over his last four games after starting scoreless.

stories.headline: McKenna doesn't see ice in final half of Maple Leafs OT loss to Sabres
stories.nhlSummary: TORONTO -- Gavin McKenna did not play in the final 32:54 for the Toronto Maple Leafs in a 5-4 overtime loss to the Buffalo Sabres at Scotiabank Arena on Thursday.

takeaways.nhl:8486067: McKenna played just 6:36 against Buffalo, lowest ice time of his NHL career, benched entire third period after defensive miscue.
